source: BCBS-IOSCO d499 Appendix B, the table the calculator uses (typed in by hand, not yet checked against the PDF)
title: Calculator haircut schedule
text: Haircut schedule used by the calculator, from BCBS-IOSCO d499 Appendix B. Cash haircut is 0 percent. Government bonds rated AA- or better are 0.5 percent under one year, 2 percent for one to five years, and 4 percent over five years. Corporate bonds rated AA- or better are 1 percent under one year, 4 percent for one to five years, and 8 percent over five years. Corporate bonds rated A+ to BBB- are 2 percent under one year, 6 percent for one to five years, and 12 percent over five years. Main index equity is 15 percent. Other equity is 25 percent. Gold is 15 percent.
